issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Files
issues.why: The spec references 'lifecycle-10-research-lifecycle.mmd' and 'lifecycle-top-research.mmd' as normative/source files, but their content is not provided in the module text.
issues.fix: Include the raw Mermaid code for both .mmd files within the provided file blocks.

issues.title: Domain Path Validation Ambiguity
issues.why: The JSON schema requires 'domains' to be relpaths to spec modules, but doesn't define if these must be validated against the disk or just string patterns.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verifies' clause to AC-RESEARCH-02 stating that domain strings must resolve to existing directories.

issues.title: Registry Table Verification Gap
issues.why: The SQL DDL for 'RegistryEntry' is provided as a contract, but there is no GWT criterion verifying the database schema matches the DDL.
issues.fix: Add AC-RESEARCH-07: 'Registry schema matches DDL' with a 'Then' clause for table/column existence.
